rationale: Task T7 requires an early-warning model for high-cost claims at arrival. Revised plan corrects three critical data-leakage issues. (1) Threshold now computed on train_only partition to prevent test-set distribution leakage into target definition. (2) Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from features—these are post-submission amounts and constitute target leakage; model uses only claim-arrival-time features (claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present). (3) Encoder and scaler now fit on train_only to prevent training statistics leakage into test-set preprocessing. Split remains 0.25. Standard scaling supports both logistic regression and random forest. Synthetic data caveat applied to report per evolved_run_006_001 skill.
changes_summary: Three critical corrections for statistical discipline: (1) target_definition.threshold_source changed from 'all_data' to 'train_only' to prevent leaking test-set distribution into target definition. (2) feature_set.features reduced from 15 to 13 by removing 'billed_amount' and 'allowed_amount'—post-submission amount fields that constitute target leakage. (3) preprocessing.fit_on changed from 'all_data' to 'train_only' to prevent encoder and scaler statistics leakage into test-set preprocessing.
